subject: loop-crested stoneware figure
art_direction: 砂陶小偶头顶竖起问号般弯环，胸口只有一枚釉色圆片，手脚短而稳。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Model a squat stoneware figure whose head extends into one curved open loop, like a physical question without lettering. Keep the face low on the head, with a tiny thoughtful mouth and asymmetrical brows. Its short hands rest on the belly around a single translucent teal glaze disc. Use rough sand-colored clay on the body and smooth glaze only in that central patch. Tilt the head slightly against a deep slate-blue background. Show subtle firing speckles and hand-pressed surfaces, avoiding mystical symbols, talismans, or a threatening expression. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
